'''kpimenatl Typical this deal is getting worse/ Pray I don't take it further''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[kpimenatl]]
* '''Published:''' 19 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Deal kpimenatl DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

To rule space and the ground!!!

The published list has 64 cards.

== Strategy ==

The Main point is to get Dark Deal down as fast as you can. Once you get that down you force drain like the dickens. If unable to do that you start wasting away at space or ground. Some of the cards add battle destiny in space. Just your typical space/ground deck with the objective.
